*"Mireille Lepan the woman of the world-famous BeyondTech as the CEO, the ice queen, the divorced three-times woman, the bitch and most of all the woman who puts her work over her family sometimes that's what page six said at least and her two previous divorced husbands thought. She was notorious for her high standards, getting what she wanted when she wanted it, that she was cold and unfeeling and she was fridge in bed."*

That's what Mireille Lepan read while she was sitting in a luxurious office, surrounded by opulence. Plush leather chairs, polished mahogany furniture, and soft ambient lighting created an atmosphere of refined elegance. Gilded accents adorned the room, while state-of-the-art technology seamlessly blended with classic aesthetics. She didn't mind what they said about her but she wouldn't want her children to read about this, and her latest ex-husband giving his statements about her bedroom life? Tasteless she thought.

Mireille Lepan she knew what she wanted, what she achieved, what she fought for, and what she wanted to provide for her twin boys. She never looked back and always kept moving forward. She put the newspaper that she was reading, even though she could have read it online and even though she was in the tech business she still liked reading newspapers. Maybe it was because she was 50 or maybe it was something else but she still liked the feel of reading newspapers. 

Well, for now,  she put what page six said about her out of her mind because she had work to do and she didn't have time to pretend her feelings were hurt. She has meetings, phone calls, emails to send, people to see and many more things she didn't want to think about this second.

Today, when she finally arrived back at her townhouse in New York, luxury welcomed her right from the doorstep. She had about 4 hours to get ready since her twin boys were with their father this weekend, leaving her to enjoy some alone time. Tonight, she had booked a high-end female escort from a very private agency.

Mireille Lepan chose to meet at a hotel suite, preferring not to bring strangers to her actual home. She went for the best option available, reminding herself to be more open-minded this time around. Past escorts had been more interested in her status, seeking career favors, which was not what she was looking for. She needed this evening to be about unwinding. Mireille knew that if anything more sexual were to happen, it would be up to the  escort.

When the knock finally sounded at the hotel suite room, she rose from the sofa and walked over to the door, opening it slowly. There stood the escort, who was visibly pretty. Mireille stepped aside to let her in. "Hello, I am Mireille." she introduced herself, trying to strike a balance between being welcoming and maintaining a bit of distance.
